bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test -f "$ROOT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" || exit 31
test -d "$ROOT/.git" || test -f "$ROOT/.git" || exit 32
PARENT="$ROOT/.worktrees"
mkdir -p "$PARENT"
test "$(realpath "$PARENT")" = "$(realpath "$ROOT")/.worktrees" || exit 33
fetch_exact(){
 git fetch --no-tags origin "$1" >/dev/null
 test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$2"
}
fetch_exact refs/heads/chat/bug-report-userbot-20261115 c2f6478e2b1f8cd04fd8a9f8d4bff7d6000b705e || exit 34
WT="$PARENT/bug-report-20261115"
if test -d "$WT"; then
 test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = c2f6478e2b1f8cd04fd8a9f8d4bff7d6000b705e || exit 35
 test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || exit 36
else
 test ! -e "$WT" && test ! -L "$WT" || exit 37
 git worktree add --detach "$WT" c2f6478e2b1f8cd04fd8a9f8d4bff7d6000b705e >/dev/null
fi
fetch_exact refs/heads/chat/userbot-report-recipient-20261115 fea455c072926aa51bdd6e095ced10fa4e96dccc || exit 38
UW="$PARENT/userbot-report-20261115"
if test -d "$UW"; then
 test "$(git -C "$UW" rev-parse HEAD)" = fea455c072926aa51bdd6e095ced10fa4e96dccc || exit 39
 test -z "$(git -C "$UW" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || exit 40
else
 test ! -e "$UW" && test ! -L "$UW" || exit 41
 git worktree add --detach "$UW" fea455c072926aa51bdd6e095ced10fa4e96dccc >/dev/null
fi
cd "$UW"
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -B scripts/test_userbot_resident_ipc.py >/dev/null || exit 42
cd "$ROOT"
LOG="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
if ! docker build --network=host --progress=plain -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-report-c2f6478 "$WT" >"$LOG" 2>&1; then
 if grep -Eq 'ERR_PNPM|frozen-lockfile|TS[0-9]{4}' "$LOG"; then exit 51; fi
 if grep -Eq 'no space left|ENOSPC' "$LOG"; then exit 52; fi
 exit 55
fi
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-report-c2f6478 >/dev/null
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-report-c2f6478 -c 'test -s /app/gaybbs.mjs && grep -q "🐞 不具合を報告" /app/gaybbs.mjs' || exit 56
printf 'USERBOT_IDENTITY_UNIT=PASS\nBUG_REPORT_IMAGE_BUILD=PASS\nCREATED_NEW_TOP_LEVEL_SIBLING=NO\n'
